summary: Rachel Gilbert is a Sydney (Alexandria) designer womenswear brand founded in 2007, selling through retail boutiques, ecommerce and global wholesale. Danny Bui became Finance Manager in December 2025 after almost four years as Financial Analyst, and a Senior Financial Analyst joined in January 2026 whose public profile lists Xero month-end, PayPal, Afterpay and Shopify reconciliations and Cin7 inventory reconciliation. The finance function is small and process-heavy, a clear fit for reconciliation automation.
